facts.statement: trigger-fire and fact-retrieval questions are wrong tracks — route them to their own tracks
discipline and reference rules are never shape-tested; record both as excluded with a routing reason
frontmatter-convention guidance is always out of scope — harness matches section spans against the body only
at any moment the workspace skill differs from the intact skill by exactly one rule's section
consume exit codes and JSON from the harness scripts only — never parse their prose stdout
source root = the directory containing the skills/ dir the skill lives in
harness is required and user-specified; no default
run the production consumer model at default temperature; campaign --model/--variant flags are the only model-selection path (eval agent pins no model config)
reps default 5 per entry per arm
timeout default 120 seconds
re-check adopted phrasings on model upgrades via the ablation track (rules whose control stopped failing)
classify every body rule: shaping (in scope), pattern (in scope, restraint-gate sub-track), discipline (pressure track), reference (retrieval track), technique (no competing shape)
if no shaping or pattern rules exist, stop: report the routings, run no campaign
inventory is rebuilt fresh from the current doc every campaign — rules.json is a diff baseline, never a cache
rules.json holds rules (id, section, kind, statement, entries) and excluded rules with routing reasons; ids section-anchored R-<section-slug>-<nn>

entries carry exactly id, rule, kind, section (verbatim span), fixtures (application always; counter-example exactly when pattern), markers (non-empty dict), restraint_markers (exactly when pattern), variants (1-3 keyed v1..v3; v0 implicit, never stored)
the fixture's job is to tempt the wrong shape — no temptation means nothing learned
fixtures are self-contained: no real files/repos/context; every path illustrative
never quote the rule text, markers, or expected shape in a fixture
include at least one requirement the tempting wrong shape cannot satisfy, forcing the failure into the open
never stack pressure (deadlines, sunk cost, authority) — the temptation is structural
one restricted agent and one workspace suffice — the v0 control is still the skill loaded, with the rule's section removed
the per-run prompt is the bare fixture text — never rule text, markers, or expected shape; the agent never knows it's a test
phase 1 runs 5 control reps for all rules; only rules whose control exhibits the failure earn a phase-2 variant run, after a second spend confirmation
pattern-rule winners run the restraint gate before adoption
non-converging rules get one round-2 mini-campaign on a changed form (cap 2 rounds), then unresolved
preflight is zero-spend: python3 >= 3.10 and evaluator.py check --harness must pass before any run
one sterile workspace suffices (unlike the retrieval track's two)
cost formula: 5 + 5×variants per failing rule; pattern +5 per gated variant, cap +10; per-rule cap 30, pattern 40
snapshot (plain cp, exact commands recorded) covers entries.json, rules.json, and the verified synced skill dir, taken before any arm rewriting
shape-scored-check takes all four counts matching the report summary and gates record
record runs only after a completed FULL campaign — never a mini-campaign — with --scope dir --track shape-test
write-backs to source SKILL.md only on explicit user confirmation; afterwards re-run the adopted rule's entry as a never-recorded confirmation mini-campaign
cleanup removes the one workspace with --prefix shape-test
entries × arms run strictly serially — one entry, one arm, one byte-state at a time; only reps within one arm batch parallelize
every section span must occur verbatim exactly once in the synced body — doc drift aborts pre-spend
void signals: skill-not-loaded, empty-answer, read-outside-workspace; timeout is NOT a void signal — an abort after a complete inline answer still scores
grep is triage, not verdict — hand-read every flagged sample; template echoes and quoted counter-examples masquerade as marker hits
convergence is judged across the 5 reps: all reps same structure = binding; five different structures = not binding
a prohibition arm is a measurement instrument, never a candidate — adopted may only name a recipe/structural arm; suppressed tokens migrating to a worse shape are displacement, not a fix
ties go to the shorter phrasing — prose length is a real cost
silent non-application: if the leading variant's outputs do not exhibit the property more often than the control, the rule is not binding — change the form
over-application exists only with the guidance loaded, so counter-example fixtures need no control arm
control never exhibits the failure → author nothing; flag an existing rule for ablation re-check — never harden a phantom
prohibition suppresses the token but the failure migrates → positive recipe stating what the output IS — never stacked prohibitions
required element omitted from an artifact the agent already produces → structural REQUIRED field/slot in the template — not a prose reminder
behavior should depend on a condition → conditional keyed to an observable predicate — not unconditional rule + exemption clauses
reps disagree on the shape → change the form, not more words — never append nuance clauses
fix between campaigns, never mid-campaign — mid-campaign doc edits invalidate every later result
keep fixtures, variant texts, and section spans verbatim within and across campaigns — editing any of them invalidates comparison

nuance/exemption clauses appended to a winner degrade it and do not scope — express a real exception as its own observable-predicate conditional tested as a new variant, or restructure so the rule cannot reach the exempted part
campaign artifacts live in the persistent campaign dir under skills-workspace/<skill>/shape-tests/ — never inside the temp eval workspace
proposal cards: '## N. <entry-id> (<kind>)', covers:, fixture:, markers:, variants:, why: — closing with coverage:, excluded:, cost: lines, nothing else wrapping the cards

reports open with four lines (shape test: <skill> — <date>, entries:, artifacts:, manifest:), then per-rule blocks (verdict heading, per-arm table, notes:, write-back:), no-failure/unresolved sections, and a final summary line

scored.json: id, kind, result (adopted/no-failure/unresolved/void), adopted_arm exactly when adopted (non-v0 arm present in results), restraint_gate pass/fail exactly when pattern+adopted (null otherwise), optional marker_counts/notes; every results id covered exactly once
multi-file artifacts need all expected files — a rep returning only one block fails even if that block looks right
no skill-load signal means the run is void — set it aside and re-run that arm before scoring

timeout voids are not always agent defects — concurrent reps share one endpoint, latency rises with parallelism; raise --timeout on a slow local server before pressure-testing the agent body (2 voids at 120 s, 0 at 300 s in calibration)

excluded.reason: installer {{SKILL_NAME}} substitution is harness plumbing, performed by the install step; no agent judgment involved
arm byte assembly (v0 span removal + one blank line, vN replacement, frontmatter preserved) is harness-internal; shape-suite performs it, the driver never does
restoring original synced bytes between arms and on abort is harness-internal
smoke-rep-first and ≤10-worker batching are harness scheduling details
results.json schema (config block, markers carried into results) is output plumbing consumed by shape-evidence
session-id reporting on abort lines is hygiene surfaced automatically by shape-evidence
workspace-init --prefix shape-test is invocation mechanics the driver performs via workspace-manager.sh; unelicitable from any realistic query (three doc placements, three consecutive misses)

over-applier disqualified / gate the next-best converging variant: no elicitation hook in the covering query's scenario (two consecutive misses); needs a dedicated gate-failure query before it can be re-clustered next campaign
